channel.title: Nate Wooding
channel.description: Coconut water reviews and other things.

item.title: O Organics — Coconut Water Original (2.4/10)
item.description: O Organics Brazilian coconut water. Organic but tastes sour and acrid — possibly the ascorbic acid. One of the worst reviewed so far. Overall: 2.4/10.

item.title: Blue Monkey — Organic Pure Coconut Water (4.4/10)
item.description: Pasteurized organic Vietnamese coconut water. Tastes burnt but not bad. Zero freshness, great if you don't like sweet water. Overall: 4.4/10.

item.title: Taste Nirvana — Real Premium Coconut Water (5.4/10)
item.description: Thai Nam Hom steam-sterilized coconut water. Claims to be the most delicious. Not organic by choice. Mildly candied sweetness, nothing floral. Overall: 5.4/10.

item.title: Kirkland Signature — Organic Coconut Water (7.9/10)
item.description: Costco's store brand organic coconut water. Unpasteurized Thai, fruity and bright, very refreshing. Likely from the same factory as TJ's and Sprouts organic. Overall: 7.9/10.

item.title: Sprouts — Organic Coconut Water (7.8/10)
item.description: Sprouts Organic unpasteurized Thai coconut water. Tastes identical to TJ's Organic — likely the same factory. Perfectly balanced, floral, and sweet. Overall: 7.8/10.

item.title: Zico Pure — Organic Coconut Water (6.9/10)
item.description: Zico's answer to Harmless Harvest. Organic unpasteurized Nam Hom water from Thailand. Better than boxed Zico but slightly too sweet and missing earthy depth. Overall: 6.9/10.

item.title: C2O — Organic Coconut Water (4.8/10)
item.description: C2O's organic Thai coconut water. Better than the standard C2O but still tastes burnt and too sweet. Low bar cleared. Overall: 4.8/10.

item.title: Sprouts — 100% Coconut Water with Pulp (5.2/10)
item.description: Sprouts Farmers Market pasteurized coconut water with pulp. Unremarkable but solid, with notably quality pulp texture. Overall: 5.2/10.

item.title: Harmless Harvest — Organic Coconut Water (8.1/10)
item.description: The classic unpasteurized Thai coconut water. Crisp, punchy, floral with no aftertaste. Industry-leading ethics. The best introduction to what coconut water can be. Overall: 8.1/10.

item.title: Once Upon a Coconut — Premium Coconut Water (4.6/10)
item.description: Donates 10% to undisclosed charities. Doesn't taste cooked but tastes too sweet and artificial. Good as a dessert water, not refreshing. Overall: 4.6/10.

item.title: Visvita — Coconut Water with Pulp (3.8/10)
item.description: Mysterious Vietnamese coconut water with a ton of added sugar and pulp. Almost soda-like sweetness. Overall: 3.8/10.

item.title: Moon Boo Sun — Organic Coconut Water (6.2/10)
item.description: Upmarket organic Vietnamese coconut water from Ben Tre. Very creamy, mild fruitiness, but not refreshing. Standard pasteurized offering despite the premium packaging. Overall: 6.2/10.

item.title: El Mexicano — Agua de Coco with Pulp (3.9/10)
item.description: Thai coconut water, pasteurized with a lot of added sugar. Smooth and milky but no freshness or floral character. Overall: 3.9/10.

item.title: Nilo — Coconut Water with Pulp (5.3/10)
item.description: Vietnamese coconut water with higher natural sugar but nothing added besides pulp. Surprisingly smooth and mellow, fresh not burnt. Overall: 5.3/10.

item.title: C2O — Coconut Water with Pulp (4.2/10)
item.description: Thai coconut water with a smidge of sugar and pulp. Pulp helps an otherwise chemical-tasting base feel more palatable. Overall: 4.2/10.

item.title: Parrot — Coconut Water with Pulp (3.1/10)
item.description: Thai coconut water with an absurd amount of added sugar and pulp. Seriously candy-sweet with a good pulp texture. Feels made for a child's palate. Overall: 3.1/10.

item.title: Simple Truth — Organic Coconut Water (6.3/10)
item.description: Surprisingly mild Filipino coconut water. Fair trade and organic, very refreshing and light. Great for exercise hydration. Overall: 6.3/10.

item.title: C2O — Coconut Water Original (2.9/10)
item.description: Thai coconut water in a sturdy can, pasteurized with added sugar. Putrid bile-y aftertaste. Impressive for a natural product to taste so artificial. Overall: 2.9/10.

item.title: Zico — Natural 100% Coconut Water (6.6/10)
item.description: Thai Nam Hom coconut water, pasteurized but brighter than most tetra-pak options. Quite refreshing with a fresh, delicate flavor profile. Overall: 6.6/10.

item.title: Vita Coco — Farmers Organic (5.2/10)
item.description: Filipino organic coconut water. Lighter than most boxed options, smooth with no bitterness. Better ethics than Vita Coco's standard line. Overall: 5.2/10.

item.title: Maui & Sons — 100% Pure (4.6/10)
item.description: Not from Maui. Vietnamese pasteurized coconut water with a slightly burnt flavor. Boring profile, not particularly refreshing. Overall: 4.6/10.

item.title: Vita Coco — Extra Coconut (4.6/10)
item.description: Coconut water with added coconut cream and gumming agent. More weak coconut milk than coconut water. Very creamy but not refreshing. Overall: 4.6/10.

item.title: Vita Coco — The Original (5.0/10)
item.description: The original mass-produced coconut water on American shelves since 2004. Sweet, slightly acrid, not offensive but not impressive. B corp but not organic. Overall: 5.0/10.

item.title: Trader Joe's — Organic Coconut Water (7.8/10)
item.description: Young Thai coconut water, unpasteurized, USDA Organic. Perfectly balanced between floral and sweet. TJ's answer to Harmless Harvest. Overall: 7.8/10.

item.title: Trader Joe's — Coconut Water (3.9/10)
item.description: Brazilian coconut water, pasteurized, tetra pak. Very mature tasting with an almost burnt flavor. Skip the shelf and grab TJ's unpasteurized instead. Overall: 3.9/10.

item.title: Real Coco — Organic Pure (5.2/10)
item.description: Mildly sweet organic Vietnamese water. Very inoffensive, almost waterlike, but surprisingly refreshing. Lots of greenwashing on the packaging. Overall: 5.2/10.

item.title: Coaqua — Sparkling (7.3/10)
item.description: Coaqua's smooth, milky profile works well with carbonation. Very lightly effervescent. Ethics remain a problem. Overall: 7.3/10.

item.title: Cocochito — with Pulp (4.1/10)
item.description: A heavily sweetened Thai water with added pulp. Bitter and sweet at the same time, with highly variable pulp. Overall: 4.1/10.

item.title: Coaqua — Still (6.6/10)
item.description: Single-origin Vietnamese coconut water with millennial marketing to match. Smooth and milky but the added sugar makes it less refreshing. Overall: 6.6/10.

item.title: Harmless Harvest — Organic Sparkling (7.4/10)
item.description: The OG pink water, carbonated. Industry-leading ethics, unpasteurized, but the floral flavor doesn't quite work with bubbles. Overall: 7.4/10.
